quotes.speaker: Jaden McDaniels
quotes.summary_phrase: Timberwolves' discipline and ability to hold each other accountable
quotes.excerpt: I feel like we hold ourselves accountable well. Like you see someone turn the ball over or
quotes.quote: I feel like we hold ourselves accountable well. Like you see someone turn the ball over or make a mistake, you see like we might come to each other, tell us our fault, like we'll do better. So just I feel like we do good by ourselves.
